thread:
Priya Kapoor: Quick docs sync — need to refactor the streaming + pagination snippets across Py/TS/Go to the new async-iterator style and add an explicit retry example for transient socket closes. I started a draft in the PR but it's messy. Can folks take owners?

Alex Chen: I can tackle Go streaming change. Which package version should we reference?

Priya Kapoor: Thanks Alex. Use go-sdk v1.4.0-alpha (we're standardizing on the new Stream() iterator). Also add note about context timeouts.

Jason Park: I'll do TS snippets and the migration blurb. Will replace the old onData callback example with the async for-await pattern. Pushing a branch now.

Emily Rivera: For Python, switching to async iterator is fine, but we need a minimal retry wrapper example for this pattern. Socket resets happen often in low-bandwidth CI. Example like:
```python
from tenacity import retry, wait_exponential, stop_after_attempt
@retry(wait=wait_exponential(min=1, max=10), stop=stop_after_attempt(3))
async def stream_with_retry(client, req):
    async for chunk in client.stream(req):
        yield chunk
```
Better to show where to plug backoff.

Priya Kapoor: Nice Emily — include comment about idempotency and when to buffer partial responses. Also add a short note on checksum/trace_id for replays.

Marta Svensson: Heads-up: docs CI will fail if examples import deprecated names. I can run the snippet linter once branches are up. Please add the migration note under "SDK changes" in the migration guide.

Jason Park: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/843 — TS streaming + retry example added. I swapped this:
```ts
client.on('data', (d) => { /* old */ });
```
for:
```ts
for await (const chunk of client.stream(req)) {
  // handle chunk
}
```
Added a small pagination helper for listResponses too.

Alex Chen: Go branch pushed: github.com/redwood-inference/docs@go-stream-refactor. Example shows use of context.Context with timeout and for-range channel read from Stream(). Also included a note about closing the stream on errors.

Priya Kapoor: Awesome. Couple of small editorial asks: 1) make the code blocks 80-char wrapped, 2) add a one-line migration checklist at top of page, 3) link to the batching guide where we mention prefix caching.

Marta Svensson: Will lint and run docunit tests after the PRs land. If anyone wants to coordinate a single PR to avoid merge conflicts, reply now.

Emily Rivera: I can fold my retry snippet into Jason's TS PR for the cross-language example, and then open a tiny follow-up for Python formatting.

Priya Kapoor: Sounds good. @docs-bot please create a tracking issue aggregating these small PRs into the migration epic.

docs-bot: Created issue #612 in docs — "SDK streaming & pagination migration (async-iterator + retries)" and linked PRs 843, 847, 850.

Jason Park: I'll rebase and drop the deprecated imports. Expect fixes by EOD.

Marta Svensson: Cool — ping me when CI green. I'll merge the migration checklist and update the TOC. :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: Thank you everyone, this unblocks a few product tickets. I'll add a quick changelog entry once all PRs merged.
